_FACTORS = {'B': 1, 'KB': 1024, 'MB': 1024 ** 2}


def to_bytes(text: str) -> int:
    digits = text.rstrip('BKM')
    unit = text[len(digits):]
    return int(digits) * _FACTORS[unit]
E
